title: Things To Do in Boone NC This Weekend | November 2026
excerpt: November in the NC High Country is quieter than leaf season — and that makes it one of the best times to experience Boone like a local. From crisp mountain hikes to warm downtown dining, here's what's happening this weekend and why it might just inspire your next move.
